summary: Sussex County, VA tower listed by the FFLA as standing as Homeville (Sussex Courthouse); no build, owner, staffing, access or fire history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing on the FFLA Virginia list, which gives no date; no later confirmation found

evidence.supports: Sussex County tower listed as standing at the stated coordinates
Forest Lookouts index places the tower in Sussex County
Wikipedia infobox photo caption says Homeville is at the intersection of Routes 35 and 40
evidence.quote: Homeville, at the intersection of Routes 35 and 40

evidence.supports: NHLR Virginia page counts 48 registered lookouts; its name table, checked in full, has no Homeville entry
evidence.quote: There are 48 lookouts registered in Virginia.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA directory line and the Forest Lookouts county index support this record. Not on the NHLR Virginia list. The brief's county, status and coordinates match the FFLA list. The name 'Sussex Courthouse' is unexplained by any source read; a search returned Sussex County courthouse history, but nothing linking a lookout to it. Two search queries found no build, owner, height, staffing or fire record.
